Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

The first arc is indeed rather forgiving and you will get the chance to build your linups as you go.
I would, however, suggest you try a bit of everything. <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968> 

> Etheral cores, used the same way as luminous cores for time-limited banners, are the only ones to expire. You *could* hoard luminous cores for the upcomming anniversary in november. <:Saya_wow:1513124172895879198> 

- Pure cores, used for the bottom 2 standard banners ( awakeners and WoDs ) are quite easy to come by. Just playing the game, in any way, will give you more than enough to pull on all realms.

And pull on all realms you should, because you will eventually want 5 functionnal teams ( 19 awakeners ) for D-tide ! <:Saya_foto:1513124059334971402> 

Before you commit for a banner, did you know you can borrow an awakener from someone else on events, see if you actually like their gameplay ? <:Saya_duel:1513123467917135903> 

*I you're absolutely lost and can't decide* : Cheri's handbook, among precious intel, includes a tier-list for beginners. Just type /new if you didn't read it yet <:Saya_key:1513122945885536378>
